violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. When tested, the chlorine concentration was zero ppm and only a small amount was available in the container that supplies chemical to the machine during operation.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: rice, noodles, and other food items.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CORRECTED

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor, in the walk-in refrigerator and walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lighting Intensity, 20 Foot Candles Minimum
violations.observation: Observed that inadequate lighting was provided in the consumer self-service areas, reach-in refrigerators, handwashing areas, warewashing areas, equipment and storage areas, and/or toilet rooms. Inadequate light at the ice machine and dry storage areas . Replace the burned out light bulbs on the ceiling above these areas.
violations.corrective_action: Increase the lighting to provide a minimum of 20 foot candles in these areas.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the cook-line was being used to store utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Do not use this sink as a storage or to wash utensils. Make all hand sinks available for use when needed.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the DISH WASHING MACHINE with a concentration of 0.0 ppm total chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. Adjust or repair the dish washing machine. In the mean time use the three-compartment sink to WASH , RINSE, & SANITIZE utensils and equipment until the machine is able to properly do so.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: the interior surfaces a opf the refrigerated units on thew cook-line were noted to be soiled , and in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. Frequently clean food contact surfaces to prevent possible contamination of foods.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked beef=46F, raw steak=43F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the kitchen being used as a trays storage.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC removed trays.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw beef stored above oyster flavor sauce in 2 DR prep on cook line and raw beef stored above soy sauce container in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC rearranged food items.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Cooked chicken( 43 from the day before), cooked skewed chicken ( 43 from the day before), shrimp triangle ( 43 from the day before). Marinated with garlic and oil on the bottom shelf on cook line,
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded aforementioned food items.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Kimchi
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: The sentence: “* the item is served raw or undercooked” is missing.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PIC will e- mail updated PDF file of the menu within 10 days.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed soy sauce buckets and carton boxes of boneless pork stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC elevated aforementioned food items 6inch above the floor.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wiping cloth in sanitizer solution.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Observed rice spoon in the water at 68F next to the rice warmer.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed and cleaned spoon properly.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer peanut butter containers were observed reused for the storage of mint in 2DR display cooler in bar and for storage mixture of salt and sugar on the shelf.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC moved food in approved containers.
